build.beforeBuildCommand: pnpm --dir ../.. wasm && pnpm --dir ../.. --filter @motionily/web build && bash scripts/bundle-runtime.sh

bundle.longDescription: Motionily is an open-source, agent-first video editor: any MCP agent (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…) builds motion graphics and edits that render live on your GPU.
